reader.requirement: At --std 85 the SD entry must accept file-name-1 followed by none, either or both of the 1985 format's clauses (RECORD clause in its three forms, DATA RECORDS) in any order; the format's brackets admit each once.

edition-consulted.switches: DATA RECORDS (Constructs.DataRecordsRemoved2002): accepted at 85, COBOL0873 at 2002+

reader.edition-search: grep CobolVersion|Edition|Std in Cst/ClauseCardinality.cs and Cst/ClosedFormats.cs: no edition reference; the SD row of ClauseCardinalities.ByClauseContext has Sequence null (order free) and no Earlier figure, so the order/once-only screen is the same arm at every edition.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: DATA RECORDS is a clause of the 1985 SD format and is accepted at 85, refused (COBOL0873) at 2023; the order-free rule is the same at every edition

reader.notes: The grammar parses sortMergeDescriptionClause+ and the closed-format/cardinality screen (Sequence null) imposes no order, only once-only. Diagnostics at --std 85 name the 2023 clause (ISO §2023:13.4.6.2) rather than the 1985 figure; cosmetic, the verdict is unaffected.
